SELECT A.TASK_ID, A.BOOKSET_ID, C.BOK_DETAIL_ID, A.HAPPEN_DATE, A.BOOK_DATE, A.BOOKSET_DATE, B.BOOKSET_DATE as booksetDate1, CD.BUSI_ID, D.ORDER_ID, D.ORDER_TYPE, D.ORDER_NUM, D.SETTLE_DATE, D.TRADE_ID, D.PS, D.MY_ACCT_NO, CD.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, D.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, VBCI.ACCT_TYPE as counterAcctNoType, D.SETTLE_AMT, D.SETTLE_STATUS, D.CCY, F.STANDARD_CCY,
DEAL_ADD.FINPROD_ID, DEAL_ADD.FINPROD_TYPE, DEAL_ADD.INV_AIM, DEAL_ADD.REGIST_ORG, ACCT.ACCT_TYPE
,DEAL_ADD.TRADE_MARKET FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO A INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING B ON (A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = B.HAPPEN_DATE AND A.BOOK_DATE >= B.BOOK_DATE AND A.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND B.BUSI_TABLE = #{busiTable} ) INNER JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING_DETAIL C ON (B.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID AND C.BUSI_NO = B.BUSI_NO AND C.BUSI_TABLE = C.BUSI_TABLE ) INNER JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID CD ON (CD.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID AND CD.BOK_DETAIL_ID = NVL(A.BOK_DETAIL_ID,C.BOK_DETAIL_ID) ) INNER JOIN STL_ORDERS D ON (B.BUSI_NO = D.ORDER_ID AND C.BUSI_TYPE = D.BUSI_TYPE AND B.HAPPEN_DATE = D.SETTLE_DATE AND D.ORDER_STATUS != #{orderStatus} )
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL DEAL_ADD ON DEAL_ADD.TRADE_ID = D.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO ACCT ON ACCT.ACCT_NO = D.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND ACCT.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID
LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_CAPACCT_INFO VBCI ON VBCI.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID AND VBCI.ACCT_NO = D.COUNTER_ACCT_NO AND VBCI.CCY = D.CCY LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS_EXT E ON D.ORDER_ID = E.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET F ON A.BOOKSET_ID = F.BOOKSET_ID
LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A1 ON (D.TRADE_ID = A1.P_TRADE_ID AND A1.TRADE_STATUS = #{orderStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) WHERE E.IS_TRADE = #{isTrade} AND A.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND A.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND A.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND A1.TRADE_ID IS NULL
AND A.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}

SELECT A.TRADE_ID as tradeId, A.FPRICE_AMT AS fpriceAmt, A.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, B.DEPOSIT_AMT as depositAmt, A.CCY as ccy, A.B_TRADE_ID AS bTradeId FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL A LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD B ON A.TRADE_ID = B.TRADE_ID WHERE A.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
SELECT S.MY_ACCT_NO, S.CCY, S.COUNTER_ACCT_NO, S.PS FROM STL_PAY_ORDERS S WHERE S.TRADE_ID= #{tradeId} AND 2 > ROWNUM
